## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

:core-sync — three symbols the fix must add: `WearableProfileSyncTransport` (implements `ProfileSyncTransport`), `WearableRecordedRaceTransport` (implements `RecordedRaceTransport`), and a `Flow<Boolean>` source feeding `LinkStateMonitor`'s `rawLinkEstablished` constructor parameter, built on the Wearable Data Layer (`DataClient`/`MessageClient`).

## Trigger

ProfileSyncPushService.push (and applyIncoming), RecordedRaceSyncService.sync, and LinkStateMonitor.observeLinkEstablished — nothing observes them: none of the three symbols above exists, so none of these call sites can run against a real device.

## Today

`ProfileSyncTransport` (core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/sync/ProfileSyncTransport.kt) and `RecordedRaceTransport` (core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/sync/RecordedRaceTransport.kt) are interfaces consumed by `ProfileSyncPushService` and `RecordedRaceSyncService` respectively; both services are fully implemented and tested against fakes, but no class implements either interface anywhere in the codebase. `LinkStateMonitor` (core-sync/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/sync/link/LinkStateMonitor.kt) takes a `Flow<Boolean>` in its constructor and derives established-link transitions from it, but nothing in production code constructs it — only its test feeds it via `flowOf(...)`. `:core-sync`'s build.gradle.kts declares no Wearable Data Layer dependency (only `:core-domain` and `kotlinx-coroutines-core`); `:app-wear`'s build.gradle.kts declares `libs.play.services.wearable`, but `:app-phone`'s build.gradle.kts does not, even though the version catalogue (gradle/libs.versions.toml, `play-services-wearable`) already declares it.

## Expected

`:core-sync` declares a dependency on `libs.play.services.wearable`, and `:app-phone`'s build.gradle.kts adds the same dependency it is currently missing (alongside `:app-wear`, which already has it). `:core-sync` gains a `WearableProfileSyncTransport` implementing `ProfileSyncTransport.send`, carrying the profile and reference down to the watch via the Data Layer. `:core-sync` gains a `WearableRecordedRaceTransport` implementing `RecordedRaceTransport.send`, carrying a recorded race up to the phone in chunks via the Data Layer. `:core-sync` gains a production `Flow<Boolean>` source, built on the Data Layer's capability/node-connection signal, wired into `LinkStateMonitor`'s `rawLinkEstablished` parameter so `observeLinkEstablished()` reports real transitions instead of only being exercised by its test's `flowOf` fakes.

## Searched

ProfileSyncTransport, RecordedRaceTransport, LinkStateMonitor, DataClient, MessageClient, Wearable, play.services.wearable, play-services-wearable
